name: @synapsedesk/api-gateway-java
//: A MAVEN project with an npm manifest, for the reason rag-service's manifest gives: turbo dispatches by workspace, and a directory with no package.json is not one. It declares NO `build`, `lint` or `test`, because turbo skips a task a workspace does not define and `npm test` must stay runnable without a JDK — Maven owns those three, through `./mvnw`. `dev` goes through `scripts/gateway-impl.mjs` rather than starting Maven directly: `npm run dev` is `turbo run dev`, so a bare `dev` here would start a SECOND gateway on the same PORT beside the Node one, and both would claim the implementation lease.
